Overview
- Purpose: tools and scripts to convert KMF (DK2 3D model format) to glTF/OBJ using Babylon.js and a Kaitai-generated parser.
- Key entry points: `kmf2gltf.mjs`, `kmf2obj.mjs`, `Kmf.js` (generated parser), `kmf.ksy` (Kaitai spec).

Use the "Start development server" vscode task for checking the validity of your changes.
